[Image: Semicircular room with 10 flat windows]

The figure shows a semicircular room seen from above. An architect is placing 10 flat windows in the room as shown. If the radius of the circle is r, which of the following equations would allow the architect to determine the width of each window?
figure_description: A top-down view of a semicircle with a horizontal straight baseline representing the diameter. Along the curved outer boundary, 10 consecutive, equal-length straight line segments (chords) are connected end-to-end to form an inscribed regular half-polygon representing 10 flat windows. A dashed line segment labeled r extends from the center of the baseline to the vertex between the second and third segments from the left.
